text:
Sabrina (AE): Heads up — Sentinel Health POC is blocked. Legal says our VPC/KMS design doesn't meet their 'key separation' requirement. They want an attestation + timeline for Private deployment by EOD tomorrow. Also asked for a dedicated burst pricing estimate. Omar can you surface with exec? :rotating_light:

Marco (SRE-Eng): Logged the ask. I pinged eng-runtime about a quick architecture note. We can provide a temporary design doc and mitigation (no customer keys on shared control-plane) — takes me ~3 hours to draft.

Priya (Sales-Eng): Can we give a ballpark for dedicated burst? They expect 500k tokens/day at peak. What's the uplift vs reserved?

Raj (Security): Need the exact KMS flow they're concerned about (bring-your-own vs our managed). If it's BYOK, we need to confirm HSM attestation and key wrapping. I can draft an attestation template but legal + infra signoff needed.

Lina (Legal): I need the specific clause they referenced. Also ask: do they require FIPS 140-2 validation or just Proof of Separation? Either way, timeline matters.

Omar (VP Sales): On it. I'll join the call at 3pm PT. Sabrina — please prep a one-pager with ask bullet points and customer quote. Also cc CISO if needed.

Sabrina (AE): Sending one-pager now. Quick note from customer: "We cannot proceed without BYOK attestation confirming keys never leave our HSM" — they already routed to procurement.

deploy-bot: New customer-requirement ticket created: SNTL-4532 — assigned to eng-runtime. Link: https://rwinf.example/tickets/SNTL-4532

Marco (SRE-Eng): Drafted a short architecture snippet:
```
- Control plane handles orchestration only
- Customer keys live in their KMS (BYOK)
- Model serving nodes access wrapped keys via approved gateway
- No plaintext keys stored on our infra
```
I'll attach to ticket.

Raj (Security): That snippet helps. I want to add: need KMS audit log forwarding and a signed attestation on key custody. Can we offer a scoped SOC2 addendum for this POC?

Lina (Legal): We can draft an addendum template. Timeline: 48-72 hrs to get legal review + redline. If we rush, we can do a short-term attestation letter in 24 hrs, but it will be high-level.

Priya (Sales-Eng): For pricing — rough uplift: dedicated burst + 2x reserved capacity delta ~ +28% on top of committed monthly. I'll formalize and post numbers in this thread by 1pm PT.

Omar (VP Sales): Priority path: Sabrina schedule 3pm call, include customer CISO. Marco & Raj prepare attestation + technical note. Lina prepare one-page legal attestation template. Priya bring pricing options.

Sabrina (AE): Call scheduled: 2024-05-14 15:00 PT. Invites sent to Sentinel CISO + procurement. Attaching one-pager and SNTL-4532 ticket link.

Marco (SRE-Eng): Attestation draft uploaded to ticket.

Raj (Security): Reviewing attestation now. Will post comments within 90 minutes.

Lina (Legal): I'll drop the starter attestation in the ticket after review.

Omar (VP Sales): Thanks team. Flagging exec escalation if legal cannot sign within 24 hrs. Sabrina keep me posted. :thumbsup:
